scientific_scope_status: For finite H_S tensor H_B, d=dim(H_S), H=I_S tensor K+V with Hermitian K,V and ||V||op<=v, all subsystem-only terms and subsystem-bath coupling belong in V. At beta>0 let rho=exp(-beta H)/Z and X=x tensor I_B for any possibly non-Hermitian x. No bath dimension, bath energy scale, geometry, gap, commutation or mixing restriction is assumed. The claimed local KMS bound is K_rho(X)=Tr(sqrt(rho)X^dagger sqrt(rho)X)>=4 exp(-4 beta v)||x||op^2/(9d)>=4 exp(-4 beta v)Tr_S(x^dagger x)/(9d^2). This is a quadratic form, not ordinary uncentered variance or a transport coefficient. When v=0 it is exactly Tr_S(x^dagger x)/d.
